title: No More Ambiguity in 360° Room Layout via Bi-Layout Estimation
venue: Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF Conference on Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition
verified_claims: Enclosed stops at ambiguous regions and encloses the room; extended reaches visible areas inside the opening.
The paper describes policy variation within MatterportLayout.
The authors report reannotating 15% of MatterportLayout labels for the enclosed branch while evaluating on the original test split.
ZInD raw/visible are described as similar to enclosed/extended, not strictly identical.
access_note: Official CVF links were returned by search and bibliography; direct web open returned 403. The author-hosted PDF was fully accessible.

title: Zillow Indoor Dataset: Annotated Floor Plans With 360° Panoramas and 3D Room Layouts
venue: Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF Conference on Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition
verified_claims: The official README defines an opening as an artificial division of a large room, later removed in postprocessing.
Partially visible geometry is locally clamped and can cease to be Manhattan even if the underlying room is Manhattan.
Complete and visible geometry extend through openings, not doors, under the dataset's protocol.
access_note: PDF destination was independently obtained from the official repository's Paper link; direct web PDF fetch returned 403. The official README and CVF proceedings citation were accessible.
